$comment: The KNOWN-BAD control: an exact published tarball (by integrity, never by version) and the EXACT harm tests it is MEASURED to fail. Each must be SEEN on this integrity (failed WITH its observation mark); one that passes means the suite has gone BLIND, and one that fails before its stimulus returned is a harness fault. Other harms run on it are reported, never judged (e.g. plain `relay mint-token` on a revoked row: 3.0.1 refuses it too, but not with the revocation wording, so it fails before its mark). MEASURED 2026-10-13 (the seed acceptance tool) and 2026-10-20 (this control, per harm).
must_fail: SEC-01.T1 HARM http: a NEW name with no registration secret is refused, and no row or token is created
SEC-20.T1 HARM relay send --from a REVOKED agent is refused and writes no message
SEC-20.T1 HARM with no token in its env, the refusal says the agent is revoked
SEC-20.T2 HARM relay mint-token --force does not bring a REVOKED agent back
